text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Dia-chan's Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Dia & Kitasan
text_block_list.text: Let's make the most of our Hatsumode visit!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This was the two of them's fervent first wish of the year.
Together, the three of us headed to the shrine for New Year's prayers.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Huuuhm... What should I wish for?
choice_data_list: Wasn't it supposed to be winning the Classic Triple Crown?
Isn't it about winning the Classic Triple Crown?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
That is something I must accomplish myself.
It is not something to ask of God to grant for me.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I will overcome this with my own strength!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...And so, when it comes to wishes for the gods,
nothing comes to mind right away,
so I always end up agonizing over it every year...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I suggested that, in that case, why not declare a 'New Year's Resolution' to the gods?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
That is a splendid idea!
Now that we have declared it before the gods, we cannot go back on our word!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Not just a prayer for victory—it's a mission for victory!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...It feels like I'm about to make
an unimaginably solemn vow.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: My resolution for this year... Simply winning the Classic Triple Crown would be far too ordinary, wouldn't it?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
As an Umamusume of Satono,
how should I run as a distinguished racer...?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (The vision of who I want to become—)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (What I need to be more conscious of is...)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I intend to run carrying my pride.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Proud, just like McQueen-san.
I shall stand before everyone with the pride
of a representative of the Satono family.
choice_data_list: I think being yourself is perfect.
I think it's great because it's so like you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Running with the elegance befitting a diamond.
It was an ambition uniquely suited to one
raised from childhood among the elite.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Kita-chan, looks like you've decided.
Now let's pray together.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yeah...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
""Spring Senior Triple Crown"...! I want to run well and earn the support of many people!
And put a smile on everyone's faces!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"I will win the Classic Triple Crown!
As a Satono Umamusume, I swear to show
everyone a truly glorious run!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though the races they aim for differ,
the radiance captured in each of their eyes is the same—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It felt as though they were running side by side until their paths crossed again.
I could sense the deep bond unique to childhood friends.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Heheh! People are starting to notice me,
little by little! So I'm gonna run in a way
that makes even more people wanna cheer for me!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Oh? I'll be captivating everyone with a run
worthy of the Diamond name too, you know?"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hmph...! I'll be the one to charm them first
with the Spring Senior Triple Crown!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Mmmph... I'll turn the tables on you
with my "Classic Triple Crown"!

text_block_list.name: Dia & Kitasan
text_block_list.text:
Muuugh, I'm gonna win!!
Muuugh, I'M the one who's gonna win!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Then let's settle this with a New Year's showdown!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
No need to worry, Trainer.
New Year's showdowns are an annual tradition.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: This is the perfect chance to settle the score!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Both of them were totally heated up, showing no sign of stopping their argument at all.
Well, if it's an annual tradition, there probably isn't any real danger...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Let's have Trainer decide what our contest will be!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Looking forward to it!
Please give us a showdown where we can compete with everything we've got!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Speaking of a New Year's-style contest where both of them can go all out...
choice_data_list: Picking up mochi at the mochi toss

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
The "New Year Umamusume Ekiden," right!
At this time... they should be passing by nearby any minute!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
It's a cheer battle!
Trainer, you be the judge!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ah, I can see the lead pack!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Keep pushiiiiing!!
They're coming up behind you! Dig deep right here!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
We can do it, we can catch up!!
Yes, that's it! That's a great pace!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume forming the lead pack
rushed past right before my eyes in the blink of an eye.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's head to the next spot!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Mountain climbing, right!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Uphills are tough for everyone! Hold on!
Don't give up!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Now is the time to endure!
Don't push yourself too hard, just go at your own pace!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Next! Let's move on!
choice_data_list: Wait, hey! How far are you going to...!

text_block_list.name: Dia & Kitasan
text_block_list.text:
"Final stretchhhh!!
Take the leaaadddd!!"

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Both teams reach the gooooaaaal almost simultaneously!
Neither side yielding an inch right up to the final moment!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that was fun!
Worked up a good sweat, didn't we~!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I got carried away and excited!
—Wait, what's the verdict on the cheering contest...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...I'm just glad we don't have to worry about gaining any New Year's weight.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Mochi scattering...?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
They throw mochi to the shrine visitors!
So the contest is about who can catch the most mochi, right?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I see, so all I need to do is pick up a lot of mochi!

text_block_list.name: Mochi Tossing Staff
text_block_list.text: Heave-hooooo!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Kyaaaaaah! Waaaaaaah!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Looks like a bunch are gonna drop over there! SEEEEIIIIHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Huh? What? ...Eek!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I... I ended up getting pushed out...
Both the Umamusume area and the general area
are super... packed...
choice_data_list: Try checking the ground behind you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Everyone is distracted by the mochi being thrown.
Surprisingly, people overlook what falls out of reach or gets missed.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you're right!
There are so many fallen behind there!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: All right, I'm gonna gather a whole bunch!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, we picked up a lot!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
A big haul, a big haul~, haaaahn-aaan âª
Let's head home and make some sweet red bean soup to eat!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We bought red beans on the way home, returned to the academy,
and the three of us ate our fill of oshiruko.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Deep-fried octopus! That sounds delicious!
Does whoever eats the most win?"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Dia-chan.
Not the octopus kind of taco, it's a kite.
You fly a kite up in the sky.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I see!
I've seen that on TV before!
A kite-flying battle sounds so fun!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'll go fry mine over there first!
Dia's Trainer, please be the judge
of who fried theirs better!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond mentioned she has almost no experience flying kites, so I demonstrated how to do it.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see... So that's how you manipulate the string...
And during the run-up, read the wind direction...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!! ...Huh~?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: That's weird, it's taking forever to fry.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Fufu, now it's my turn!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As Satono Diamond ran lightly, the kite floated softly into the sky.
She adjusted her run-up to match the wind, catching the breeze perfectly.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, you're so good, Dia-chan!
All right, I won't lose either!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Seiyaaaaaa!! ...Ah!
They're fried to perfection!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I was waiting for you, Kita-chan!
The real showdown starts now!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond with her theory and technique.
Kitasan Black with her drive and grit.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The way they flew their kites reflected their individual personalities,
and both kites soared proudly through the sky.
